title: Scan Repair for Foundation Models: artifacts (saved logits, correction results and timings)
description: Saved base-model predictions (TabPFN-2.5 context ladder, TabICLv2, tuned XGBoost and CatBoost), every post-hoc correction result, and the CPU/GPU timings behind the AccML 2027 paper 'Fix What the Model Leaves Behind: Fast Subgroup Repair for Tree Ensembles and Tabular Foundation Models'. Used with the code repository scan-repair-foundation-models to rebuild every table, figure and number of the paper on a CPU.
